typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DatabaseId as string ()
}

source(output(
		SchemaName as string,
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		ValueName as integer,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string,
		SourceSystem as string,
		ItemDefinition as string,
		IsNullable as integer,
		PhysicalItemIdSource as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select   	 [SchemaName]=cast (\'Default\' as nvarchar(50))            ,[TableName]=cast (\'Default\' as nvarchar(50))            ,[ColumnName]=cast (\'Default\' as nvarchar(50))            ,[ValueName]=null 		         ,[TableColumnValueFlag]=cast(\'C\' as nchar(1))                                                  ,[SourceSystem]=cast (\'Default\' as nvarchar(20))            ,[ItemDefinition]=cast(\'defaut value for this mapping\' as nvarchar(150))                        ,[IsNullable]=0 ,[PhysicalItemIdSource]=cast (\'Default\' as nvarchar(50))',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> Defaultvalue	source(output(
		PhysicalItemId as integer,
		SchemaName as string,
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		ValueName as string,
		LinkLevel as string,
		Type as string,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string,
		DomainId as string,
		Id as string,
		Deleted as integer,
		InScopeFlag as boolean,
		Origin as string,
		SourceSystem as string,
		ItemDefinition as string,
		CustomItemDefinition as string,
		LineofInsurance as string,
		StewardGroupId as integer,
		Databaseid as integer,
		IsNullable as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select  * from tracker.PhysicalItem where tablename= \'Default\' ;',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
Defaultvalue derive(DatabaseId = toInteger($DatabaseId)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(Defaultvalue@TableName == LookupLKPTABLE@TableName && Defaultvalue@ColumnName == LookupLKPTABLE@ColumnName && DerivedColumn@DatabaseId == LookupLKPTABLE@Databaseid && Defaultvalue@SchemaName == LookupLKPTABLE@SchemaName,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		DatabaseId = DerivedColumn@DatabaseId,
		SchemaName = Defaultvalue@SchemaName,
		TableName = Defaultvalue@TableName,
		ColumnName = Defaultvalue@ColumnName,
		ValueName = Defaultvalue@ValueName,
		TableColumnValueFlag = Defaultvalue@TableColumnValueFlag,
		SourceSystem = Defaultvalue@SourceSystem,
		ItemDefinition = Defaultvalue@ItemDefinition,
		IsNullable = Defaultvalue@IsNullable,
		PhysicalItemIdSource = PhysicalItemIdSource,
		PhysicalItemId = PhysicalItemId,
		LinkLevel = LinkLevel,
		Type = Type,
		DomainId = DomainId,
		Id = Id,
		Deleted = Deleted,
		InScopeFlag = InScopeFlag,
		Origin = Origin,
		CustomItemDefinition = CustomItemDefinition,
		LineofInsurance = LineofInsurance,
		StewardGroupId = StewardGroupId,
		Databaseid = Databaseid
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string,
		IsNullable as boolean,
		ValueName as string,
		ItemDefinition as string,
		Databaseid as integer,
		PhysicalItemIdSource as string,
		SourceSystem as string,
		SchemaName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		TableName,
		ColumnName,
		TableColumnValueFlag,
		IsNullable,
		ValueName,
		ItemDefinition,
		Databaseid = DatabaseId,
		PhysicalItemIdSource,
		SourceSystem,
		SchemaName)) ~> TrackerPhysicalITem
